poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Stand tall with a shoulder-width palms-up grip and elbows beside your ribs.

poses.label: Pause
poses.description: Curl halfway and hold for two seconds without swinging.

poses.label: Finish
poses.description: Finish curling toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows beside your ribs.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar slowly toward your thighs.

limitations: The reference pauses at the top. ThoeneFit’s exact catalog variant pauses halfway on the way up.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
